title: Crafted .doc could loop forever in the piece-table walk
cause: Signed skip length allowed p to stand still or move back
fix: Unsigned length, strictly increasing cursor, unit test (fp-legacy)

title: PDFs fail on iOS 16-17.3, Safari 16 and older Android WebViews
cause: pdf.js modern build needs Promise.withResolvers and newer built-ins

title: A render superseded mid-load could write into the newer render and leak observers
cause: No abort checks after awaits; stale cleanup stored
fix: main.ts releases superseded renders; abort checks in delegate/fallbacks (fp-legacy)

title: Document hyperlinks navigated the preview frame (incl. javascript: hrefs)
cause: docx-preview renders live <a href> from relationships
fix: Intercept clicks, confirm bar, http(s)/mailto only (fp-office)

title: Object URLs for images/fonts leaked on every re-render
ResizeObserver could stay attached after a re-render; canvases kept alive
cause: Registered after an await without an abort check; no canvas release
fix: Abort checks; canvases zeroed; document destroyed (fp-media)

title: Stale root.onscroll kept the previous document alive
cause: reset() did not clear renderer handlers

title: GIF controls could land in a newer toolbar; HTML links unwired after a slow iframe load
cause: Missing abort check; wiring only once
fix: Abort check; re-wire on each load (fp-media)

title: Quadratic work on many field pairs (.doc) or long-space cells (CSV)
Text fallbacks fail before Safari 16.4; zip bombs inflate everything
cause: DecompressionStream('deflate-raw') unguarded; unzipSync without a filter
fix: Feature detection with fflate fallback; entry filter and size cap (fp-legacy, fp-office)

title: Muted text contrast 4.40:1 in sheet headers
